name: Jira search
desc: 50 issues with descriptions, people, links and repeated metadata.
command: twg jira workitem query --jql "assignee = currentUser() ORDER BY updated DESC" --first 50 --fields summary,status,assignee,reporter,description,priority,issuetype,created,updated,labels,components,project -o json
provenance: Captured TWG response shape; all business content and identifiers replaced with synthetic values.

name: Jira: all fields
desc: 30 issues with full custom fields, rich text, comments and nested metadata.
command: twg jira workitem query --jql "assignee = currentUser() AND statusCategory != Done ORDER BY updated DESC" --first 50 --fields "*all" -o json
provenance: Captured TWG response shape; all business content and identifiers replaced with synthetic values.

name: Jira batch details
desc: Three full issue envelopes with rich text and supplemental details.
command: twg jira workitem get DEMO-101 DEMO-102 DEMO-103 --full -o json
provenance: Captured TWG response shape; all business content and identifiers replaced with synthetic values.

name: Confluence search
desc: 50 page results with excerpts, duplicate titles, links and coverage metadata.
command: twg confluence search query --cql 'type = page AND lastmodified >= now("-7d") ORDER BY lastmodified DESC' --limit 50 --excerpt -o json
provenance: Captured TWG response shape; all business content and identifiers replaced with synthetic values.
